svg.aria-label: README.TXT. Hi, I'm Gabriele. I make things under the name Lelevisione: graphic design, interaction and virtual environments, with cultural heritage seen through a cathode-ray screen. Art historian by training, now finishing an MSc in Digital Humanities at the University of Pisa (Graphics, Interactivity and Virtual Environments). My thesis lives in XR. Curricular intern at the Institute of Mechanical Intelligence, Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna, building a virtual environment inspired by the Alinari photographic archive. I have also published research on location-based games and cultural heritage. C:\> open portfolio.exe
